author: srengel
body:
ex. CLB2 has a bunch of computational annotations from GO_central (https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000006323/go#comp ) 18 of 20 of which are wrong. 

It's the IBA annots,  CLB2 controls G2/M NOT G1/S

CLB1 and 2 are G2/M, 
CLB3 and 4 are replication and spindle assembly so considered S/G2 and M,
CLB5 and 6 are G1/S early S phase.

required action: All the G1/S annots for CLB1, 2, 3 and 4 should be removed.
title: PAINT issue: All the G1/S annots for CLB1, 2, 3 and 4 need to be removed

author: marcfeuermann
body: Hi Stacia, Thanks for pointing this out. The CLN family is one of the largest PANTHER families, with more than 2,300 sequences. Its topology is quite complex, making it difficult to determine which stage of the cell cycle is controlled by each cyclin. I’ve attached an excerpt containing the S. cerevisiae sequences. I’ve removed the specific annotations and propose annotating the family with GO:0051726 (regulation of cell cycle). This should resolve the issue. Best, Marc
